title: Latent Projection for Latent Planning
abstract: arXiv:2610.26979v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Latent world models let an agent plan in latent space. The planner searches for an action sequence that minimizes a cost, and that cost is often the $\ell_2$ distance between the predicted terminal latent and the goal latent. The latent, however, is partly noise: the regularizer that prevents collapse during world model training promotes variance in the directions carrying no signal. We show that the same regularizer also supplies the structure to prune that noise in the latent. SIGReg drives the latent marginal to a standard Gaussian at every step, and assuming further that the latent sequence is a Gauss-Markov process, the transition is linear with its covariance pinned by the map itself, $z' \mid z \sim \mathcal{N}(Az,\, I - AA^\top)$. Fitting the state dynamics $A$ therefore yields the covariance at no additional cost, and in its eigenbasis each latent direction carries its own uncertainty. translated_title: 面向潜空间规划的潜空间投影
translated_abstract: 潜世界模型使智能体能够在潜空间中进行规划。规划器搜索使代价最小化的动作序列，而该代价通常是预测的终端潜变量与目标潜变量之间的 ℓ2 距离。然而，潜变量中有一部分是噪声：世界模型训练中用于防止表示坍缩的正则化器会在不携带信号的方向上促进方差。我们证明，同一个正则化器也提供了剪除潜变量中这些噪声的结构。SIGReg 使潜变量的边缘分布在每一步都趋于标准高斯分布；若进一步假设潜变量序列为高斯-马尔可夫过程，则其转移是线性的，且协方差由映射本身所确定：z′ | z ~ N(Az, I − AAᵀ)。因此，拟合状态动力学 A 无需任何额外代价即可获得协方差，并且在其特征基下，每个潜变量方向都携带自身的不确定性。此外，将 A 约束为正规矩阵……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现世界模型训练中防止坍缩的正则化器（SIGReg）本身蕴含高斯-马尔可夫结构，可零额外成本地导出潜空间各方向的协方差（不确定性），从而在潜空间规划中有效剪除不携带信号的噪声维度。
en_tdlr: The same regularizer that prevents representation collapse (SIGReg) also reveals a Gauss-Markov latent structure, providing per-direction uncertainty at no additional cost, which enables pruning of signal-free noise in latent planning.
